mapper.select: SELECT q.quiz_id, q.quiz_type, q.difficulty, s.name AS sector_name, 'SINGLE' AS item_type FROM quiz q JOIN sector s ON q.sector_id = s.sector_id WHERE q.is_active = TRUE AND q.quiz_type IN (1, 2, 3) AND q.quiz_id NOT IN ( SELECT quiz_id FROM quiz_result WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT qs.set_id, s.name AS sector_name, COUNT(qsi.item_id) AS question_count, 'SET' AS item_type, 4 AS quiz_type FROM quiz_set qs JOIN sector s ON qs.sector_id = s.sector_id JOIN quiz_set_item qsi ON qs.set_id = qsi.set_id WHERE qs.is_active = TRUE AND qs.set_id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT qsi2.set_id FROM quiz_set_item qsi2 JOIN quiz_result qr ON qsi2.quiz_id = qr.quiz_id WHERE qr.user_id = #{userId} ) GROUP BY qs.set_id, s.name ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT q.quiz_id, q.sector_id, q.quiz_type, q.difficulty, q.news_content, q.question, q.explanation, q.is_active, s.name AS sector_name FROM quiz q JOIN sector s ON q.sector_id = s.sector_id WHERE q.quiz_id = #{quizId}
SELECT choice_id, quiz_id, choice_no, content, is_correct FROM quiz_choice WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} ORDER BY choice_no
SELECT qs.set_id, qs.sector_id, qs.title, qs.news_content, qs.is_active, s.name AS sector_name FROM quiz_set qs JOIN sector s ON qs.sector_id = s.sector_id WHERE qs.set_id = #{setId}

SELECT q.quiz_id, q.sector_id, q.quiz_type, q.difficulty, q.news_content, q.question, q.explanation FROM quiz_set_item qsi JOIN quiz q ON qsi.quiz_id = q.quiz_id WHERE qsi.set_id = #{setId} ORDER BY qsi.item_order
SELECT choice_id FROM quiz_choice WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} AND is_correct = TRUE LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_result (user_id, quiz_id, selected_choice_id, is_correct) VALUES (#{userId}, #{quizId}, #{choiceId}, #{isCorrect})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_level SET points = points + #{points}, level = CASE WHEN points + #{points} >= 2000 THEN 4 WHEN points + #{points} >= 500 THEN 3 WHEN points + #{points} >= 100 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT points FROM user_level WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT vocab_id, term FROM vocabulary WHERE #{text} LIKE CONCAT('%', term, '%') ORDER BY LENGTH(term) DESC
